name: Strategy 3
description: Strategy 1 with one change: a CHoCH needs a candle to CLOSE beyond the protected level (and beyond the AVWAP for a trend flip) instead of touching it. Everything else as Strategy 1 — 1-minute candles, swings / BOS by touch, stop at the previous swing.
